fusions.name: Sleight of Sight
fusions.desc: Looses 3 flicks of arcana at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Stalled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lifted Opening
fusions.desc: A thrown flick that deals 9 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Swapped Place
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. Using it increases your movement speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Picked Pocket
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.
